SAP Single Sign-On Certificate Renewal

SAP SSO certificates expire annually and must be renewed to prevent authentication failures.

Symptoms

  • Users receive "Authentication Failed" or "Certificate Expired" errors
  • SAP login page loads but credentials are rejected
  • Other LDAP-authenticated applications work normally

Resolution Steps

  1. Log into SAP Identity Provider admin console
  2. Navigate to SAML Configuration > Service Provider Certificates
  3. Generate a new X.509 certificate with 2-year validity
  4. Export the certificate and upload it to the SAP Trust Manager
  5. Update the metadata XML on all connected service providers
  6. Restart the SAP ICM service
  7. Ask users to clear browser cache before retesting

Prevention: Set a calendar reminder 30 days before certificate expiry. Consider automating certificate rotation with the SAP Certificate Lifecycle Management tool.
